content:
# Testament of Reuben — 1
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Cantabrigiensis) | **Section:** Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs

---

1:1 A copy-of-the-words of-Reuben, which-he-commanded his-sons before he-died, in-the hundred-and-twenty-fifth year of-his-life.
1:2 When his-brothers came to-visit him, he-said to-them: I am dying, and I go-the-way of my-fathers.
1:3 And-he-saw [there] Judah, and Gad, and Levi, and all-his-brothers assembled.
1:4 And-he-said to-them: Listen, my-brothers, and give-ear to Reuben your-brother, the-things which I command you.
1:5 Behold, I-call-to-witness against-you this-day the-God-of-heaven, that you-do not-walk in-the-ignorance-of-youth and-in-fornication, which I myself committed and-which defiled-me before Bilhah, the-concubine of-my-father.
1:6 And-I-tell you that-God struck-me with a-great-plague in-my-loins for seven-months.
1:7 And if-not [that] my-father Jacob prayed for-me to-the-LORD, surely he-would-have-killed me.
1:8 I was thirty years [old] when I worked-this-evil before-the-LORD; for seven-months I was sick and I-repented-with-all-my-soul before-the-LORD.
1:9 Wine and-strong-drink I-did-not-drink, and-flesh did-not-enter into-my-mouth, and-I ate-no-pleasant-food; but-I-was-mourning over-my-sin, [for it was] great; and-it-became-no-small-thing in-Jacob my-father.
1:10 And-Jacob did-not-cease praying for-me; for-I had-sinned against Bilhah, his-beloved.

2:1 And-now listen to-me, children, that-I-may-tell you what I-saw concerning the-seven-spirits of-deceit in-my-penitence.
2:2 Seven-spirits are-given against-man from Beliar: and-they are-the-heads of-the-deeds-of-youth.
2:3 And-the-first is-the-spirit of-fornication, which-is-enthroned in-the-nature and-the-senses;
2:4 and-the-second is-the-spirit of-insatiability, in-the-belly of-the-stomach;
2:5 and-the-third is-the-spirit of-strife, in-the-liver and-the-gall.
2:6 And-the-fourth is-the-spirit of-flattery and-sorcery, that-through over-eagerness one-may-be-beautiful.
2:7 And-the-fifth is-the-spirit of-pride, that-one-may-be-boastful and-arrogant.
2:8 And-the-sixth is-the-spirit of-lying, in-destruction and-jealousy to-feign-words and-conceal-things from-kindred and-friends.
2:9 And-the-seventh is-the-spirit of-injustice, which-steals and-does-crooked-deeds, that-one-may-gain-what-he-desires; and-it-moves-against one-who-gives to-the-needy.

3:1 These [are] the-seven-spirits against-man; but-the-spirit of-sleep also-comes with-the-spirit of-truth and-the-spirit of-sight, and-leads-man to-ignorance, weighs-down his-eyes, and-out-of fear-of-Beliar and-through-hard-sin brings-a-heaviness upon-him in-sleep.
3:2 These are-the-sins-of-fornication: fornication itself, heat-of-desire, deceitful-beauty, and-adultery.
3:3 For-fornication is-the-mother of-all-evil, separating-man from-God and-bringing-him-near to-idols;
3:4 because-it-deceives-the-mind and-understanding, and-leads-young-men into-Hades before-their-time.
3:5 For-many-times fornication has-corrupted-men, nobles and-mighty-men, kings and-priests and-prophets, and has-led-them-astray from-the-commandment-of-the-LORD.
3:6 For David the-king fell-before Bathsheba, who-was-the-wife of-Uriah, and-he-sinned [against] Uriah unto-death.
3:7 And I too-sinned because-of Bilhah, the-wife of-my-father, having-seen-her-bathing in-a-hidden-place.
3:8 For-I left-no-impure-thought in-my-mind, but-I said in-my-heart that-it was not-evil, and I-did-not-awaken my-father.

4:1 And-now, my-children, love-the-truth, and-it-will-preserve you. Hear-the-commandments-of-Reuben your-father.
4:2 Give-not-heed to-the-face-of-a-woman, and-be-not-alone-with-a-woman-of-the-female-sex, and-consort-not-with-affairs-of-women.
4:3 For if-I had-not-seen Bilhah bathing, I-had-not-fallen into-this-great-iniquity.
4:4 For-my-mind, taking-in-the-form-of-her-nakedness, suffered-not-to-sleep until it-committed-the-iniquity.
4:5 For-while my-father Jacob was-absent at-[the-house-of] Rachel our-mother, the-evil-spirit of-fornication attacked-me; and-I went-in-and-saw Bilhah drunk-with-wine-and-sleeping-uncovered in-her-chamber.
4:6 And-I loved-her greatly, and-I lay-with-her and-committed-iniquity; and-I left-her sleeping, and-went-out.
4:7 And-immediately an-angel-of-God revealed-to-my-father [what-I-had-done], and-he-mourned over-me and-touched-her-no-more.

5:1 Beware-therefore-of-fornication, my-children; and-if-you-wish to-be-pure-in-mind, guard-your-senses from-all-women.
5:2 And command-the-women likewise not-to-associate-with-men, that-they-may-be-pure-in-mind.
5:3 For-constant-meetings, though-the-ungodly-deed-be-not-worked, are-to-them-an-irremediable-disease; and-to-us-a-destruction-of-Beliar and-an-everlasting-reproach;
5:4 for-in-fornication there-is-neither-understanding nor-godliness, and-jealousy reigns over-it.
5:5 Hear-me then, my-children, in-the-days-of-my-death: put-away-from-you fornication, and-love-truth, and-let it-guard-your-ways.
5:6 For-a-man-who-fornicated defiled-himself before-God; and if-he-[is] a-son-of-the-covenant he-will-never-be-pure-in-his-heart-before-the-LORD, being-weighed-down-by-an-evil-thought.

6:1 For-these-things I-command-you; and-I say-to-you: Obey Levi, because-he-shall-know the-law-of-the-LORD, and shall-make-atonements for-all-Israel until-the-consummation-of-the-times, as-the-anointed High-Priest, of-whom the-LORD spoke.
6:2 I-adjure you by-the-God-of-heaven: do-the-truth-each-one to-his-neighbor, and-keep-the-law-of-the-LORD and-his-commandments.
6:3 For-the-LORD will-be-exalted by-Levi and Judah; for-the-LORD has-chosen them to-be-among-the-people.
6:4 And-there shall come upon-them a-blessing-of-the-LORD from-the-fruit-of-their-seed forever; for-I know that-the-children-of-Israel will-not-persist in-their-goodness.
6:5 And after-I had-admonished them, I said: Hear-me, my-sons; for-I saw in-my-writing-of-the-generations-of-my-fathers that-you-will-finally-depart from-the-LORD, walking-in-all-evil and-working-the-abominations-of-the-gentiles, and-walking-after-the-wives-of-the-Canaanites, and-the-daughters-of-the-Canaanites.
6:6 For-this-reason shall-you-be-carried-away-in-exile, and-you-shall-receive-all-the-plagues-of-Egypt, and-all-the-evil-things-of-the-Canaanites.
6:7 And-among-the-gentiles you-shall-be-for-a-reproach and-for-a-curse, until-he-returns and-visits-you with-compassion, as-he-promised-to-your-fathers.

---
*End of Testament of Reuben*
